test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 1 Aug 2016 was Monday, what would be the day on 1 Aug 2012?
solution: Given: **1 August 2016** was Monday. Now, 2016 to 2012 = 4 Years (3 Ordinary Years and 1 Leap Year). And, In 4 Years = 1 Leap Year and 3 Ordinary Years.
